chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Abū al-ʿAbbās, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a man divorces a woman during his illness, she inherits from him so long as he remains in that illness, even if her ʿiddah has ended, unless he recovers from it.
I said: What if the illness lasts a long time for him? He said: She inherits from him for up to one year.
ai.seo_question: Does a wife divorced during her husband’s illness still inherit from him in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a woman divorced by her husband during the husband’s terminal or serious illness. She continues to inherit from him while he remains in that illness, even after her ʿiddah ends, unless he recovers; if the illness continues, this inheritance ruling extends up to one year.
